convert_mpsd_scene_to_wai: convert an MPSD scene into WAI format with metric depth, intrinsics, and camera extrinsics
run_mpsd_conversion_pipeline: run the MPSD to WAI conversion pipeline for all scenes using the argconf configuration
get_mpsd_scene_names: get all original MPSD scene names from reconstruction data directories with optional scene filters
get_mpsd_recon_split_map: get a mapping from MPSD scene names to their reconstruction split names
review_convert_scene: review the convert_scene function that processes MPSD images, depth maps, and camera poses into WAI format
